blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Vice President Sara Duterte on Monday said that the cases presented during her impeachment trial are already failing, noting that the pieces of evidence against her are all fabricated. Duterte made this statement when she was asked to make an assessment of her ongoing impeachment trial. “Bumabagsak na yung kaso nila. Kaya binibilisan, kasi wala na, wala na sila masabi,” Duterte told reporters on the sidelines of the kick-off celebration of the 91st anniversary of the Office of the Vice President.
